_comment: Spawn tables by map: which teams each node spawns, on which turns and with what odds. Any map can have one; each entry's _source says where its table comes from (a ranking guide in Recomp/rank_guides, a recording, the stc). Rules as in map_config.json (gfserver/missions._spawn): turns are enemy turns (from_turn 1 = the enemy turn after our turn 1). A map with a table here uses it instead of recorded live runs and the heliport fallback; a mod's or the player's own spawns for a map replace it. Read by gfserver/missions._table_spawn_rules.

10674._source: Assassin Eclipse's MS Ranking Notes: 7 prespawns of 35091 CE (L1, L19, L5 in the stc; R8 patrol, H2 / H3 / H6 on Alert, which stay put until their heliports are revealed), R3 11268 CE patrol; 35091 CE spawns on H2, H3 and H6 every turn once revealed and not clogged, 13230 CE on H8. H1, H4, H5, H7 and H9 never spawn. H8 spawns 13230 CE teams like the L4 / L23 prespawns (the user): 44430011, the one 13230 CE team no node uses, on Alert like H2 / H3 / H6's 44430003.

Easy turns 1-2 id03-06, 3-4 id07-09; Normal 1-2 id10-13, 3-4 id14-16; Hard 1 id17-20, 2 id21-24, 3-4 id25-28, and Dreamer (id29) always on H11 on enemy turn 4 unless clogged (the guide doubts she comes on Easy or Normal). idXX = team 94113XX. The four prespawns (id01 / id02) are in the stc. ASSUMED: the heliport sets go Easy 92545.., Normal 92565-92576, Hard 92577-92588 (gfserver/missions.DIFFICULTY_HELIPORTS); H11 is the one next to N23 (92580 in the Hard set); every revealed heliport spawns each enemy turn while empty.

ELID, top right: 95399, 95401 and the two neutral ones nearer the HQ (95395, 95397); bottom right (the polluted zone): 95336, 95338; the ELID boss 9550116 always on turns 6-7. Military (third party, ally teams, spawned as forces on belong-0 heliports): the three high-score heliports (95376, 95379, 95383; fixed teams 9550117 / 9550118 / 9550120 = the notes' 1-3) and the two low-score ones in the one-way pocket (95373, 95374); the left starting heliport and the supply point (95387, 95334) take the low-score teams once the military holds them (the server doesn't yet hand a spot to the military when its force ends a turn there, so these two don't fire yet). The quadrant's four enemy heliports are the stc's belong-2 heliports in that quadrant of the map (the guide's prespawn coordinates, (x, y) on a 500 grid from the bottom-left, put its 80k stacks on the four centre heliports, which never spawn). Each quadrant's four heliports hold its stc standing forces (allies 65491x0-x2) until its mission skill (NW 6540008, NE 6540009, SW 6540010, SE 6540011) removes them; heliports with a force on them spawn nothing, so a quadrant spawns only once opened. Turn bands are map turns, not counted from a quadrant's opening (confirmed by the user).
